name: Business Advisory
strapline: Better information. Better processes. Better decisions.
description: Practical support to understand how your organisation really performs, simplify the way work gets done and give management the information it needs to decide with confidence.

solutions.name: Business 360° Diagnostic
solutions.tagline: A holistic assessment of the organisation and its improvement priorities.
solutions.summary: A structured, independent review of how strategy, people, processes, performance, risks and controls work together, resulting in a clear and prioritised improvement roadmap.
whoItIsFor: Owners and directors who want an objective view of the business before the next stage of growth.
Management teams dealing with recurring issues whose root cause is unclear.
Organisations preparing for investment, restructuring or a change in leadership.
whatWeAssess: Strategy, objectives and how performance is measured
Core business processes and key hand-offs
Principal risks and the controls that address them
outcomes: A 360° diagnostic report with findings rated by impact and urgency
A prioritised improvement roadmap with owners and timelines
Quick wins that can be implemented immediately

solutions.name: Process & SOP Transformation
solutions.tagline: Review, simplify and strengthen processes before documenting practical procedures.
solutions.summary: We map how work actually happens, remove duplication and weak points, and then document practical Standard Operating Procedures that people will genuinely use.
whoItIsFor: Growing organisations where knowledge sits with a few individuals.
Teams experiencing errors, delays or rework in key processes.
Organisations that need documented procedures for certification, audit or onboarding.
whatWeAssess: Segregation of duties and approval points
System usage, manual workarounds and data quality
outcomes: A practical SOP manual with clear roles, steps and controls
Implementation and training support for process owners

solutions.name: Management Reporting & KPI Setup
solutions.tagline: Establish meaningful information, indicators and reporting for better decisions.
solutions.summary: We help you define the few indicators that matter, design a management reporting pack and set up the routines that turn data into timely decisions.
whoItIsFor: Leadership teams that receive a lot of data but little insight.
Organisations introducing performance management for the first time.
Boards and owners who want a concise, reliable view of the business.
whatWeAssess: Strategic objectives and the drivers behind them
Existing reports, data sources and reporting cycles
outcomes: A KPI framework with definitions, targets and owners
A management reporting pack and dashboard template
A reporting calendar and review routine
